pullQuote.text: One last time this year — LET’S GO BLUE JAYS!

body: Looking for somewhere in the NorthSide to watch tonight’s **Game 7 of the World Series**? The energy couldn’t be higher, and a few local towns are turning public spaces into full-on Jays zones. Whether you’re in Newmarket, Aurora, or Bradford, you can join fellow fans for one more unforgettable night of baseball under the lights.
